effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP until your opponent's turn ends. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack a player.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon attack players, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 play cost 4 or lower black or red card among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
